title: Change Approval v1 (Draft)
description: Draft Pack 1 value object recording role-based approval for a governed change. It is not a universal audit-event model and is not adopted.

approvalId.description: Stable identifier for this approval record.

approvedAt.description: ISO 8601 date and time at which approval was given.

authorityRole.description: Role or organisational authority under which approval was given; never a hardcoded list of named people.

actorReference.description: Optional stable reference to the assigned actor who exercised the role. Display names do not belong here.

reason.description: Business reason recorded for the governed change.

sourceReference.description: Optional stable provenance reference. Provider payloads and secrets are excluded.
